# sheets. Generated by oracle/java/SigProbe.java.
#
# The end-of-step state, which is what a beam recogniser answers to: extension,
# hooks and grouping have all run. Records are grouped by page -- a `sheet`
# record starts a new one -- and only the beam-related inters are kept, since
# the rest of the SIG belongs to GRID and HEADERS and is pinned elsewhere.

#   sheet <file>#<n> <step>
#   inter <system> <id> <class> <shape> <staff> bounds <x> <y> <w> <h>
#         grade <g> ctx <c> frozen <b> impacts <name> <v> ...

#   allegretto 75/7/53    BachInvention5 192/2/110   batuque 98/10/64

#   hove 52/0/49          zizi 44/8/38
#
# chula is not representative on its own, which is why all eight are here: it
# has no small beams, and BachInvention5 is the only page where extendBeams
# fires at all.
#

#   unset JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS

#     -I rust/oracle/java/staff-impacts.init.gradle :app:sigProbe \
